results.evidence: cottonwood/runs.py now raises RunError('ended', 'is later than now') when the parsed ended time is after now. The new test pins timeutil.utc_now to 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z and runs record-run with --started '2026-11-30 09:00' --ended '2026-12-01 01:00'. It asserts exit code EXIT_REFUSED, a stderr line starting 'error: ended:', and 0 rows in agent_runs. I ran the tests with .venv/bin/pytest and both passed (2 passed). The second test checks that an ended time equal to now is still accepted. I did not separately confirm that EXIT_REFUSED equals 1.
